ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Sower
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Every spring it's {PAWN_nameDef} out in the fields first, a seed bag on {PAWN_possessive} hip. More of what grows here went into the ground by {PAWN_possessive} hand than anyone's, and the colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Sower.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Tinker
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Anything that breaks around here ends up in front of {PAWN_nameDef} sooner or later, and usually works again by supper. People have started calling {PAWN_objective} Tinker.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Wrecker
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has taken apart more of the colony than anyone else ever built. It was all on purpose, {PAWN_pronoun} insists. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Wrecker anyway.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Warden
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent more hours talking through cell doors than anyone, and knows every prisoner's name and story. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Warden.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Patchwork
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has been on the operating table more often than anyone here, and has the stitches to show for it. People call {PAWN_objective} Patchwork, fondly, mostly.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Bottomless
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: The cooks have done the sums, and nobody in the colony has eaten more than {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_nameDef} says it's a compliment to the kitchen. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Bottomless.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Old Hand
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has been here longer than anyone, and remembers when the walls were a line scratched in the dirt. The newcomers call {PAWN_objective} the Old Hand, and ask {PAWN_objective} where things are.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Unshaken
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Raids, losses, hunger and long winters, and in all of it {PAWN_nameDef} has never once come apart. No one here has gone longer without breaking. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Unshaken.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Lucky
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: A whole year here and {PAWN_nameDef} hasn't taken so much as a scratch: not from raiders, not from animals, not from a falling plank. Nobody else can say that. People touch {PAWN_possessive} sleeve for luck now and call {PAWN_objective} Lucky.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Homegrown
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent more of {PAWN_possessive} childhood here than anyone, and has never really known anywhere else. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} Homegrown, and means it warmly.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Jailbird
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Of everyone who has ever slept in the colony's cells and stayed on, {PAWN_nameDef} slept there longest. People call {PAWN_objective} Jailbird, and {PAWN_nameDef} has decided to find it funny.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Mender
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Whenever a quarrel gets left to fester, it's {PAWN_nameDef} who ends up patching it, with a joke or a cup of something or a hand on a shoulder. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Mender.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Haggler
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: No one here has struck more deals with the traders than {PAWN_nameDef}, and the traders have started to sigh when {PAWN_pronoun} walks up. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Haggler.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Vault
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Somehow everyone knows that {PAWN_nameDef} is the one to tell things to, and that nothing told to {PAWN_objective} ever gets out. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Vault.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Mourner
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has spoken at more of the colony's graves than anyone. When someone is lost, people look to {PAWN_objective} for the words now, and they call {PAWN_objective} the Mourner.
